results.name: fixture sanity: the lxml-written formatted note reads back as written (independent probe) and as text in our model
an edit inside plain text, inside a bold word, at the start of an italic word: only the edited span changes; inserted text takes the previous character's formatting
line breaks: typing \n splits the paragraph (new one keeps FootnoteText), deleting a break joins paragraphs, deleting everything keeps the reference mark
a note holding another reviewer's tracked change is edited in place: the call says "kept" and the revision survives
randomized differential: 60 random edits — note text always equals the request; every character outside the changed span keeps its formatting; save → re-open → lxml text agrees

diffHunks (from-scratch Myers): on 400 random string pairs the hunks rebuild the target exactly and the edit count equals an independent DP insert/delete distance; two separate edits leave the text between them — and its formatting — alone

POI corpus (6 files, every footnote / endnote): a random mid-note edit keeps the text exact, keeps each untouched character's formatting (independent lxml probe before vs after), keeps references sound
